title: A rectifiable current with almost everywhere integer multiplicity is integer multiplicity
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, T ∈ D_n(U), and let (M, θ, ξ) satisfy IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ with T(ω) = τ(M,θ,ξ)(ω) = tauAction n M θ ξ ω for all ω ∈ D^n(U). If θ(x) is a natural number for Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. x (Hⁿ = μHE[n]), then T is integer multiplicity.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n), IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, T ω = tauAction n M θ ξ ω) → (∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M), ∃ k : ℕ, θ x = k) → IsIntegerMultiplicity T
